title: Dataclass Features
prompt:
Write three dataclasses in `solution.py` demonstrating advanced features:

**Requirements:**
1. `@dataclass(frozen=True)` class `Config` with `host: str` and `port: int = 8080`. Frozen dataclasses are immutable.
2. `@dataclass(order=True)` class `Priority` with `level: int` and `name: str`. Ordered dataclasses support comparison operators.
3. `@dataclass` class `Tasks` with `title: str` and `items: list = field(default_factory=list)`. Add an `add(self, item)` method that appends to `items`.

**Examples:**
```python
c = Config("localhost")
c.port          # 8080
c.host = "x"    # raises FrozenInstanceError

Priority(1, "low") < Priority(2, "high")  # True

t = Tasks("TODO")
t.add("item 1")
t.items         # ['item 1']
```
hints: order=True auto-generates comparison methods from field order
field(default_factory=list) creates a new list per instance
Never use mutable defaults: items: list = [] is a bug!

solution.py.description: Import dataclass and field from dataclasses

solution.py.name: add
solution.py.description: Define an add method on Tasks
